story_type: pararescue hoist onto a cargo ship far offshore
hook: 300 miles off Mexico, hanging over a cargo ship on one cable.
narration: Three hundred miles off Mexico, this crew hung over a cargo ship on one cable.
A sailor on board was hurt, so the California Air National Guard sent its pararescuemen.
They rode the hoist down and got him ready to lift.
Below them, the ship's crew waited on deck.
outcome: They got him to Cabo San Lucas, and a plane flew him on to San Diego.
title: Hoisted onto a ship 300 miles out
description:
On Nov. 29, 2012, pararescuemen from the California Air National Guard's 129th Rescue Wing hoisted onto the cargo vessel Cary Rickmers about 300 miles off the coast of Mexico to rescue an injured ship hand.

Footage: U.S. Air National Guard video by Capt. Alyson Teeter, 129th Rescue Wing, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/192002/rescue-operations
